headline: Apple Watch AI features for conversations enter beta with Live Rewind and Siri Recaps
summary: The new 'Audio Intelligence' technology includes Live Rewind to catch missed phrases and Siri Recaps for high-level conversation notes, now available to developers in iOS 27.3 beta.
details: Apple's AI-powered "Audio Intelligence" technology for the Apple Watch is now rolling out into beta testing. It's initially available for developers in the iOS 27.3 update, following its announcement at the company's Surprise and Shine hardware event in September.

This technology introduces four opt-in AI features for Apple Watch Series 12 wearers: detecting important sounds, identifying songs, catching up on conversations, and taking notes. The sound recognition feature aids deaf and hard-of-hearing users by identifying sounds like sirens or alarms, while song recognition uses Shazam to detect music.

The more potentially controversial features, Live Rewind and Siri Recaps, focus on listening to human conversations. Apple has designed these features with privacy in mind, aiming to be useful without infringing on the privacy of those around the user, addressing concerns seen with other AI recording devices.
Live Rewind allows users to go back in time to review what was just said, in case they missed it. A double-press on the Watch's digital crown displays a text snippet of the last 15 seconds of speech.

This snippet can be viewed and then disappears permanently if not saved, or it can be saved to the standalone Siri app for later access. When activated, an audible chime and animation signal that something has been recorded.

Siri Recaps takes ambient listening further by enabling Apple Watch owners to get high-level notes of their conversations. Apple emphasizes it does not identify speakers, save raw audio, or provide word-for-word transcriptions.

Instead, the feature summarizes conversations with short sentences and bullet points highlighting key information like dates, deadlines, or pricing. This is designed to mimic a user's ability to jot down notes, without adding emotion or tone, useful in scenarios like work meetings or parent-teacher conferences.

Users are prompted to review saved Siri Recaps and choose which to keep, with unsaved recaps deleting within seven days. The feature can be manually enabled, scheduled for specific times, or turned off at any point from the Control Center.
